audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Volibear every row 1-5 and the first-item row to Skill/Aatrox in a way that contradicts the already-audited aatrox__volibear mirror.
audit.why: Mirror states: Levels 3 and 4-5 to Aatrox, First item to Aatrox, Two+ items Skill; Levels 1-2 and Level 6 Volibear. Both directions must agree.
audit.corrected: L1 Volibear, L2 Volibear, L3 Aatrox, L4-5 Aatrox, L6 Volibear, First item Aatrox, 2+ items Skill — proposed as matched full/content pairs with inverse ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes cited no cooldowns and credited Volibear's R with attack speed, which comes from the passive, not Stormbringer.
audit.why: Riot text: Stormbringer leaps, slows, grants bonus Health and disables nearby enemy towers. Attack speed is The Relentless Storm (passive).
audit.corrected: Stormbringer 160/135/110s with bonus health and tower disable; The Darkin Blade 14/12/10/8/6s; Umbral Dash 9/8/7/6/5s; Frenzied Maul 5s; World Ender 120/100/80s written into spikes and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Aatrox ability was ever named, and the decisive interactions (attack-based stun vs Umbral Dash, Sky Splitter's self-shield condition, Frenzied Maul's two-cast heal) were absent.
audit.why: Thundering Smash stuns the first enemy he ATTACKS at 300 range, so a dash out dodges it; Sky Splitter shields Volibear only if he stands in his own blast; Frenzied Maul heals only on the second cast against the marked target.
audit.corrected: Stated in spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2], mid, phases[2].why, phases[3].why and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] wrote 'Relentless Storm' for Volibear's passive.
audit.why: The passive is The Relentless Storm.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Aatrox under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields you only if you stand in your own blast. Aatrox's Umbral Dash (7s) heals off each hit, so his sustain edges level 3.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Aatrox down every time World Ender is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: The Darkin Blade hits 8s here while Frenzied Maul stays 5s — trade only when his Q is spent, or his passive heal wins the long exchange.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Aatrox under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer (160s) disables his tower and hands you bonus health on the leap. This is the one window where you dive through World Ender.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Aatrox to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Aatrox's first item plus Deathbringer Stance healing outscales you here — Executioner's Calling before he spikes keeps the all-in yours.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Aatrox can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: It evens out with two items: hold Stormbringer until World Ender is spent, keep anti-heal up, and never charge Thundering Smash into a ready Q3.

edits.before: Level 3 is a hard tilt to you: full W-proc-plus-E combo beats his healing before it stacks.
edits.after: Level 3 tilts to Aatrox: Umbral Dash (7s) heals off every hit and dodges your 300-range Q stun.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 remain yours as your extended-trade damage and Relentless Storm ticks out-sustain his Q edges.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 go to Aatrox as The Darkin Blade drops to 8s and his passive heal outlasts your 5s Frenzied Maul.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you — your R's attack speed and health let you walk through his Q3 knockup.
edits.after: Level 6 favours you — Stormbringer's bonus health lets you leap on him through his Q3 knockup.

edits.before: At first item your Sundered Sky/Trailblazer spike overpowers his all-in threat.
edits.after: First item goes to Aatrox unless your Executioner's Calling lands to cut his healing.

edits.before: Two-plus items still favour you because you can hold R for after his and win the re-engage.
edits.after: Two-plus items even out: hold Stormbringer until World Ender is spent and you win the re-engage.

edits.before: Once you have all three basics you win every extended trade: bait Aatrox's first Q sweet-spot, W-proc him and E on top so he can't reposition for the follow-up casts.
edits.after: Bait The Darkin Blade's sweetspot, then Thundering Smash — the stun lands on the attack, so Umbral Dash (7s at rank 3) dodges it if you charge in early.

edits.before: Your R gives you attack speed, health and Q un-slow-able bursts; walk him down through his Q3 knockup and you out-sustain his passive heal.
edits.after: Stormbringer (160s) grants bonus health and disables his tower — use it to dive, not to duel a World Ender that heals through your Frenzied Maul.

edits.before: After Sundered Sky or Trailblazer you brute-force his all-in — E slow into Q flip pins him under tower before his W drag lands.
edits.after: Executioner's Calling before Sundered Sky — Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash healing are what beat you at one item, not his burst.

edits.before: From 3 onward every all-in is yours. Bait his Q, W-proc for the empowered bite heal, and E on top to lock the trade; his sustain can't match yours once your Relentless Storm ticks. At 6 your R walks him down through his combo.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 belong to Aatrox: The Darkin Blade drops to 8s and Umbral Dash heals off every hit. Trade only on his spent Q — Frenzied Maul's second cast on the marked target is your heal, and it needs 5s and an attack to land.

edits.before: All-in whenever your passive Relentless Storm is stacked
edits.after: All-in when The Relentless Storm passive is fully stacked

edits.before: Land all three Q edges to stack healing and knock you up
edits.after: Land all three Darkin Blade edges — the third knocks you up

notes: Aatrox's W (Infernal Chains) carries a 'grounding' derived flag, but Riot's own description says only damage + drag-to-centre. Per the kit rule I did not assert grounding anywhere. Left the tldr/winCon/diff alone — 50.37% over 1340 games supports diff 6/10.
